display.purpose: Nav, labels, numerals, KPI values, page titles, login wordmark. Same family as body — Inter — differentiated by weight/case/tracking only.

body.purpose: Table content, form fields, user-authored text.

label.purpose: Uppercase small labels: status lamps, table headers.

textScale.name: 2xs
textScale.purpose: Table headers, status-lamp labels, KPI-lane captions

textScale.name: sm
textScale.purpose: Empty states, KPI sub-captions, inline errors

textScale.name: md
textScale.purpose: Panel titles, login subtitle, nav lane item labels

shadows.name: overlay-card
shadows.purpose: Login gate card — the one lifted, non-board-plane surface.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind anything floating above the board (mobile drawer today).

motion.name: flap-clatter
motion.purpose: FlapText's one authored moment: login wordmark and dashboard KPI values only. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: drawer-slide
motion.purpose: Mobile nav drawer open/close, transform-based to avoid layout-thrash.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call to action (e.g. login submit).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2760d1; color: #fff; padding: 0.65rem 1rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 600; border: none; border-radius: 0; width: 100%; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2354bd; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5b8dff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav Lane
components.description: Sidebar navigation row: icon, label; no sequence number. Active state is a background wash, never a colored border.
components.html: Inicio
components.css: .ds-lane { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; color: #99a1ab; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 0.86rem; } .ds-lane-active { background: rgba(47,111,237,0.16); color: #eef0ec; } .ds-lane-active .ds-lane-icon { color: #5b8dff; }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: Domain status indicator: lamp shape + color + text label, never color alone. Three states shown: on-time, warning, critical.
components.html: A tiempo En riesgo Vencido
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; margin-right: 1rem; } .ds-lamp-dot { width: 0.55rem; height: 0.55rem; } .ds-lamp-ontime { color: #5b8dff; } .ds-lamp-ontime .ds-lamp-dot { background: #5b8dff; border-radius: 50%; } .ds-lamp-warning { color: #d9a441; } .ds-lamp-warning .ds-lamp-dot { background: #d9a441; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-lamp-critical { color: #d64545; } .ds-lamp-critical .ds-lamp-dot { border: 2px solid #d64545; border-radius: 50%; width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; }

components.name: Board Panel
components.description: The system's card equivalent: square corners, hairline seam border, no shadow at rest.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #1a2026; border: 1px solid #262e35; border-radius: 0; } .ds-panel-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; color: #99a1ab; margin: 0; padding: 0.9rem 1.1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #262e35; }

narrative.overview: Toner's operations shell reads as a departures board, not a SaaS admin template. Every list is a live board where a row's state — on time, at risk, cancelled — is the thing the page exists to show. The system won this world in Impeccable's own direction roll against an assigned synoptic-weather-board candidate, on the strength of a real pending product need (real-time status) the board's clatter-and-flip grammar answers directly. The palette is Restrained: near-black ground and warm-white ink carry the surface, with one signal-blue accent for interactive/on-time state; amber and red are reserved status lamps, never decoration. One typeface (Inter) carries the whole system — an earlier pass with a second condensed display face and numbered nav/form/KPI lanes read as an AI-generated costume rather than considered design, and both were cut after user review.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black board ground, zero corner radius anywhere
One signal-blue accent; amber/red are reserved status lamps
One typeface (Inter) throughout; weight/case/tracking carry hierarchy
No sequence numbers on nav, forms, or KPIs — icon + label carries identity
Status is always lamp-shape + color + text label together
Hairline seams do the work cards and shadows usually do

rules.name: Never-Color-Alone
rules.body: Every status pairs its color with a distinct lamp shape and a text label.

rules.name: One-Voice
rules.body: Inter is the only typeface; hierarchy comes from weight, case/tracking, and the type scale, never a second face.

rules.name: No-Numbering
rules.body: Nav items, KPI lanes, and form fields are identified by icon + label, never a sequential 01/02/03 badge.

rules.name: Seam-Not-Shadow
rules.body: A panel at rest is separated by a 1px seam, never a shadow; shadow is reserved for genuine overlays.

dos: Do pair every status color with a distinct lamp shape and a text label.
Do use Signal Blue as the only interactive/brand accent.
Do set every weight of hierarchy in Inter — weight, case/tracking, and the type scale, never a second face.
Do separate panels with a hairline seam, not a shadow.
Do give any container that might host a wide table min-width: 0.
Do animate drawers via transform, never width/height/padding/margin.
donts: Don't reintroduce the icon + big-number + label card grid for KPIs.
Don't use a colored border-left/right to mark an active row.
Don't add a second brand accent color.
Don't add a second display typeface — it reads as a metaphor costume, not typography.
Don't prefix nav items, form fields, or KPI labels with a sequence number.
Don't apply the FlapText clatter motion outside the login wordmark and dashboard KPI values.
Don't leave the mobile drawer focusable while visually closed.
